title: Figure profile
description: One historical figure/regime. A future LIVE news event reuses the SAME 'scored_action' shape (see live-event hook below) so the live phase plugs in without a rewrite.

score_version.description: Version of THIS figure's score. Bumped on any change; changes are dated in changelog.json, never edited silently.

lean.description: ideological lean, for the symmetry/balance audit

scored_actions.description: The reasoning trail. Each entry ties an indicator to a source. This is the unit the LIVE phase emits per news event.

date.description: when the action occurred (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD); enables the creep timeline

note.description: one line: the specific act that matched the indicator

competence.description: Tracked SEPARATELY; never folded into the authoritarian headline.

computed.description: DERIVED at build time from scored_actions + rubric.json. Never hand-entered.

$comment: LIVE-EVENT HOOK (not built in v1): a news event is { event_id, headline, date, scored_actions[], sources[] } -- identical scored_action shape -- scored by the same lib against the same indicators.json. Do not build the pipeline now; the shape is reserved.
